text:
A thin converging lens is used to produce a real image of an object.
Which statement about the real image is always correct?
A
It is nearer to the lens than the object.
B
It is on the opposite side of the lens to the object.
C
It is the same size as the object.
D
It is upright.

options.label: A
options.text: It is nearer to the lens than the object.

options.label: B
options.text: It is on the opposite side of the lens to the object.

options.label: C
options.text: It is the same size as the object.
